title: The GameCube: A Console with Hidden Gems and Upcoming Remasters
text:
In depth article discussing the GameCube, from significant games to hidden gems, upcoming remasters and the Nintendo Switch Online library updates. Also mention Zelda Twilight Princess, Melee Smash, Ikaruga and other great female protagonists, offering nostalgic in-depth gaming related topics.
The GameCube was never one of Nintendo's best-selling consoles, but its most significant games paved the way for so many that followed. Zelda: Twilight Princess was never meant to have any kind of multiplayer support, but modders have made it a hilarious reality.
Nintendo gamers have just been treated to one of the free games they've been crying out for, and it couldn't have come at a better time. GameCube games are coming to the Nintendo Switch Online service on the Switch 2, but there are still many games that are not available yet. With so many hidden gems on the Nintendo GameCube to choose from, Nintendo should start by adding these classics to the Switch 2's NSO feature.
The rumors are true - GameCube will be playable on the Nintendo Switch 2 via NSO, including The Wind Waker and other classics of the console. 10 iconic GameCube games that deserve a remaster on Switch 2. These classics could shine with enhanced visuals, improved controls, and new features. A new rumor suggests that the Nintendo Switch Online library may be getting its biggest update yet, potentially adding Nintendo GameCube titles.
The GameCube is home to an extraordinary library of games, and all of the best titles are still well worth seeking out and playing today. From the tedious Super Monkey Ball 2 to the unnerving Ikaruga, these games are inarguably the GameCube's hardest titles ever. While often forgotten in favor of other Nintendo consoles, the GameCube had some great female protagonists, including Samus Aran from Metroid Prime.
The GameCube had a packed library of games in its day, and from Mario to Zelda, these are the best action-adventure titles as voted on by Ranker. An entertaining CG render of a GameCube-shaped hot tub is making the rounds on the internet again, giving players a big dose of nostalgia. Base on these facts, several topics may be extracted out.
